Name: Fire
Description: A wood fire burning in a garden fire pit. The flames puff at the rate their width sets and roar harder in a gust; the wood crackles as the water and resin in its cells burst, the big ones throwing an ember onto the brick; steam hisses out of the log ends; now and then a log gives way (FireSpec.GardenFirePit, FireSynth). The ring of brick round it is separate boxes. Its collider is the bed: placed bigger the fire is bigger, and a round collider makes a round bed (FireSpec.KeyForPlaced).
